page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-96-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It is equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture and provides 756.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include GPU accelerators, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided.

From a resource density perspective, the c4d-highmem-96-lssd offers a high-capacity memory allocation paired with a substantial physical core count, making it suitable for workloads requiring significant memory capacity without the need for dedicated graphics hardware. While structured benchmark data is not available for this specific instance type, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. The lack of bundled public IPv4 addresses and GPU hardware represents a design tradeoff that optimizes the server for secure, backend memory-intensive workloads.

This server configuration is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Suitable applications include large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and heavy data-processing pipelines. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio also supports virtualization and containerized microservices that demand substantial RAM allocations per container.
